test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:

P: the students

Q: who excelled in academics

R: were awarded

S: during the ceremony
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **PQRS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "the students," which is correctly represented by **part (P).**
 
• Following "the students," the description "who excelled in academics" **(PQ)** logically comes next, specifying which students are being referred to.
 
• **The next part,** "were awarded," **(PQR)** continues the sentence by describing what happened to those students.
 
• **Finally,** "during the ceremony" (PQRS) completes the sentence by indicating when the awards were given, thereby forming a grammatically and logically correct sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **PQRS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (SPRQ):** This option starts with "during the ceremony, were awarded the students," which creates an incorrect and awkward sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2 (PQSR):** This option places "during the ceremony" before "were awarded," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (RSQP):** This option starts with "were awarded who excelled in academics," which is incomplete and grammatically incorrect as it lacks proper context.
